/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /workspace/galaxy_outputs && python - <<'PY'
import csv, os, statistics
from collections import defaultdict
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
with open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']) as f:
    key=f.read().strip()
gi=GalaxyInstance(os.environ['GALAXY_URL'], key=key)
out='/workspace/galaxy_outputs/treeness.tsv'
gi.datasets.download_dataset('f9cad7b01a472135e613aba6f918e620', file_path=out, use_default_filename=False)
vals=defaultdict(list)
with open(out, newline='') as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\\t'):
        if row['status'] == 'ok':
            vals[row['group']].append(float(row['value']))
for group in ('fungi','animals'):
    print(group, len(vals[group]), format(statistics.median(vals[group]), '.10g'))
diff=statistics.median(vals['fungi'])-statistics.median(vals['animals'])
print('fungi_minus_animals', format(diff, '.10g'))
PY"
